QuestionStmt.S: The time required for 90% completion of a certain first order reaction is 1 hour. Calculate the time required for 99.9% completion of the same reaction.

Solution.S:
Step 1: For a first order reaction, the time required for a given percentage completion is proportional to the logarithm of the ratio of initial to final concentration.

$$t = \frac{2.303}{k} \log \frac{[A]_0}{[A]}$$

Step 2: For 90% completion, $[A] = 0.1[A]_0$, so $\frac{[A]_0}{[A]} = 10$.

$$1 = \frac{2.303}{k} \log 10 = \frac{2.303}{k} \Rightarrow k = 2.303 \text{ h}^{-1}$$

Step 3: For 99.9% completion, $[A] = 0.001[A]_0$, so $\frac{[A]_0}{[A]} = 1000$.

$$t = \frac{2.303}{2.303} \log 1000 = 1 \times 3 = 3 \text{ hours}$$

Final Answer: $$\boxed{3 \text{ hours}}$$

Hence, the correct option is C.
